pattern: EX-08 safety hazard inside a routine job (hung-up cut branch over a communal path, wind warning); landlord's own contractor not answering; IM-L03 own contractor
notes: Appended event 039 (new) after the real event 038 (7 December hold: waiting for provider to confirm all done). Event 039 is an email from the tenant (Henry) at 07:48 on Monday 8 December: the landlord's contractor took most of the tree down on Friday 5 December (the date set at event 037) but left a cut branch hung up about 4 m over the communal side path, with a wind warning from the afternoon and children walking under it. Everything from the source's event 039 on is dropped. Expected: treat it as an urgent safety issue, not a routine completion chase: tell the tenants to keep off the path and keep children away, phone the landlord and his contractor to make it safe today, and escalate to a human with authority to commission an emergency make-safe (tree surgeon or cordon) if neither can act in time.
